content.text: In regions where conventional payment platforms like Stripe fail, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-explained-digital-creators-8|COREMERCH guide to digital]] creators face significant barriers. Countries like Nigeria and Venezuela often find established solutions inaccessible. COREMERCH provides a robust [[LINK:https://coremerch.[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-what-13|GitHub Pages]].io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-5|infrastructure]] that allows you to deploy a digital store that accepts crypto payments seamlessly. This guide focuses on using Supabase as the order database for your digital store, ensuring you maintain full control over your assets without intermediaries.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often impose restrictions that stifle digital commerce in many regions. COREMERCH's infrastructure is built to counter this by leveraging open-source technologies. By using platforms like Supabase, you gain a reliable, scalable order database that operates independently of the limitations imposed by conventional payment systems. This empowers you to control your digital assets while ensuring a smooth transaction process for your customers.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before starting your deployment, ensure you have a GitHub account for hosting your front end and a Google account for Apps Script. Familiarize yourself with Supabase, which will serve as your order database. You also need to set up a NOWPayments account to handle cryptocurrency transactions. With these tools in place, you’re ready to create a solid foundation for your digital store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your Supabase database to manage orders effectively. Create tables for customers, products, and transactions. Next, set up Apps Script to connect your GitHub Pages site with Supabase, ensuring that order data flows seamlessly from your store to the database. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to process cryptocurrency transactions, allowing you to accept payments without needing conventional bank support. This pipeline is crucial for a fully operational digital store.
Gain full ownership of your digital store without reliance on traditional payment platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live. Test your website thoroughly to ensure all components function correctly. Make a test purchase to verify that the transaction flows smoothly from your customer to Supabase via NOWPayments. This step is critical to confirm that your store is ready for real customers. After confirming functionality, promote your store to your audience, highlighting the benefits of crypto payments.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Monitor your Supabase database for performance and optimize queries as necessary. Consider adding more products and leveraging marketing strategies to reach a wider audience. You can also explore the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to enhance your infrastructure further, benefiting from advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, ensuring your digital store is robust and reliable.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.

Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
